title: Identity, account session, and operation lifecycle dossier surfaces

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers memberships cache-first, resolves account documents, remembers/sorts the last account, activates one account, subscribes to broad account data, derives lookup indexes and applies financial filtering in memory. Switching/deactivation removes listeners and clears in-memory context but does not own durable pending-work disposition.
surfaces.notes: Target account session is a lifecycle capability, not a Firestore-listener container. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Authorized Accounts and membership/financial capability derive from validated Principal and active server membership
No hidden rows are downloaded for in-memory filtering
Remembered Account selection is convenience only and cannot grant access
syncRequirements: Bootstrap Account catalog and caller membership/capability stream
One encrypted environment/Principal/Account local database namespace
Workspace switch cancels prior observations and keeps queued work in its original Account

migration.rule: Correlate source Account/member IDs to stable target IDs and import only namespaced last-selection preference when still authorized; do not migrate listener/cache mechanics.
reconciliation: Account/member/Principal ID and role/financial-permission coverage
Remembered selections resolve only to active imported memberships

tests: Cross-Account local-row and pending-operation isolation tests
acceptance: Account discovery distinguishes cached/stale/unavailable from no membership and switching cannot leak or misroute rows/operations

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines the implemented provider-free environment-, Principal-, and Account-scoped pending-work summary, exact confirmation/request fingerprints, clean/sync-first/destructive evaluation policy, cancellation no-request behavior, stable failures and narrow AccountSessionEnding port.
surfaces.notes: Target-only Phase 1 verified surface. Exact implementation commit bf9a00ca45c8054018ab6f021aab13386ba24872 passed immutable Actions run 33663785835 with four focused/all 168 target tests in 39 suites, graph/contracts, both staging builds and clean artifacts. The bounded contract owns only loss-prevention, exact summary/confirmation and session-ending port semantics; it chooses no Auth provider, offline lease, UI copy, physical store/key mechanism, revocation retention, adapter, hosted resource or production behavior.

securityRequirements: Every summary, confirmation and request is bound to one validated target environment, Principal and Account; a payload identity is not provider authorization
Ordinary logout cannot destroy pending operations or unverified attachment bytes, and destructive removal requires exact current-summary confirmation
syncRequirements: Pending work distinguishes queued, applying and unresolved-rejected operations from unverified captured attachments without equating local acceptance with server apply
Sync-first can complete only after a fresh zero-pending summary; interrupted or stale cleanup fails closed

migration.rule: Define a target-only safety contract and import no Firebase session, listener, cache, pending-media directory, provider token or logout state.
reconciliation: Later local-store and provider adapters must reconcile exact Account-scoped operation/media counts and prove cleanup ordering without cross-Account loss

acceptance: Synthetic contract tests prove clean, sync-first and exact-confirmed destructive dispositions, canonical restart and fail-closed stale/scope/tamper behavior without signing out a provider or deleting data

surfaces.notes: Target-only Phase 1 implemented surface. Exact ready commit ae16ed4e62ee2abe7ab60f71a26a92824e70fa01 passed immutable Actions run 33666363647. Four focused/all 172 target tests in 40 suites, graph/contracts, both staging builds and repeatable project generation pass locally for the bounded provider-free discovery/selection implementation. It cannot authenticate, prove membership, authorize or activate an Account, choose an offline lease, persist remembered state, switch streams/queues, access a provider, define schema/RLS/Sync, wire app/MCP, migrate source data or activate production. Exact implementation-commit CI remains before verification.

securityRequirements: Every snapshot and intent is bound to one target environment and stable Principal; typed scope is evidence, not fresh server authorization

syncRequirements: Ready, partial, stale, unavailable and authoritative-empty discovery remain distinct across canonical restart
Remembered state may reorder a currently visible Account but never auto-selects, grants access or survives membership loss as authority
Actual workspace activation, stream switching and offline authority are deferred to separately gated coordinators and adapters

acceptance: Synthetic zero/one/many, remembered ordering, restart, scope/tamper/refusal and exact provider-free port tests pass without authenticating, authorizing or activating an Account
